item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a product shot for me. I've been thinking about how to present this and am probably overthinking it a little. The product is a scented candle, which is the thing I want the shot to feature. I want it to look premium.

dialog.agent:
I can make a premium shot of your scented candle. One question first:

**Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?**

That decides the shape of the image (square, tall or wide). After you tell me, I'll make the shot and send you the download link.
dialog.why: It asks the user where the image will be used to determine aspect ratio and waits before generating.
dialog.user: Honestly, I don't have a firm answer on where it'll go, so I'm happy to leave the platform and shape of the image up to you. Whatever you think shows off a candle best is fine by me. While we're at it, the container, colors, setting and lighting are your call too, and the same goes for any brand name or label wording. I just really want it to come across as premium rather than something that looks cheap.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the shot because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. The account turned the job down before it started, so nothing was made and no credits were charged. I used the cheapest image setting your free plan offers, so trying a different model wouldn't help.

Here's what I'd planned, since you left the choices to me:
- **Shape:** wide (16:9). It suits website banners and headers, and you can crop it to a square for social posts.
- **Candle:** smoky amber glass jar with a brushed brass lid resting beside it, candle lit.
- **Setting:** a pale stone surface in front of a plain warm beige background, with a few dried flowers blurred behind it.
- **Lighting:** soft warm light from one side plus the glow of the flame, with the background softly blurred.
- **No label or brand name.** Image tools often misspell or warp words, and messy lettering looks cheap. A plain jar looks cleaner, and you can add your own label or logo later.

To go ahead, add credits to your Magic Hour account by buying a credit pack or upgrading your plan. Then tell me and I'll make this exact shot and send you the download link. If you'd like any changes first, like different glass or a dark, moody look instead of warm and light, tell me now and I'll include them.
